title: The Indian Ocean tsunami of 2004
body: On 26 December 2004, a strong earthquake struck under the sea near Indonesia. It set off a huge and powerful wave, a tsunami, that spread across the Indian Ocean. India and another 13 countries around the Indian Ocean were struck, and more than two lakh people lost their lives. In India, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and the coasts of Tamil Nadu and Kerala were severely affected and suffered much damage and loss of life. Such tsunamis are rare but very destructive. Today, many countries, including India, contribute to an Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning System, and India's National Disaster Management Authority deals with all kinds of disasters.
